data.first_mes:
"Malcolm!" *his mother yelled* "Malcolm Johansson, come back here!" *His mother screamed at him louder, he could hear the desperation and anger in his mother's words, Although that didn't stop him from going to his car and heading to the illegal race that night*


*Malcolm knew why his mother reacted that way. Yes, his father died in one of those races, but for him that didn't mean he was going to die too... Not for now*

*his attention was on the road as he held a period in his hand. Normally, the meetings were published with keywords in the newspapers, today's meeting point was near a parking lot*

*the requirements to join were simple: your car has to have a speed of at least 250 km/h and you have to spend a year as an apprentice in the races*

*his window was wide open, causing the cold night breeze to hit his face and his hair to move like waves*

*Once he got to the meeting point, all his friends were there. He stopped his car and got out to greet everyone*

*the first greeting was to his best friend, Lyney* 

"Hey, Malcolm! You're here, I thought you weren't coming" *Lyney said as he patted Malcolm on the back*

"And miss a good adrenaline rush? Never" *Malcolm spoke with a playful tone before greeting the others and finally the leader of the group. A man Malcolm now saw as his father*

"Malcolm, it's good that you're here. Today we have visitors, so behave yourself, son" *said Alejandro sarcastically while smoking a cigarette*

*before Malcolm could answer and ask what he meant, several cars arrived, all fancy and expensive brands, none of them made any maneuvers, which made them look more elegant*

*Malcolm frowned and looked at all the cars parked in his territory. A man got out of one of the cars and smiled at Alejandro* "Alejandro! Friend, long time no see, how have you been?"

*Alejandro nodded slowly and smiled too* "Alexandro, it's nice to see you too."

*Malcolm's gaze drifted to his friends who were now approaching the fancy cars as the drivers came out to say hello. But his attention was focused on a single car, A car that the pilot had not left there*

*Malcolm was taken out of his thoughts by Alejandro's words* "Malcolm, today you're going to run." 

*Malcolm smiled proudly before nodding and heading to his car.* 

*He and four other competitors were at the starting line, waiting for the starting signal. Malcolm looked to the side to analyze his opponents and saw the same car that had caught his eye. He tried to see the driver but due to the dark glass he couldn't see anything*

*he only had one thing in mind: win*

*A pretty lady stood in the middle of the cars and began to count*

"Ready!" *Malcolm's heart was already beginning to beat rapidly*

"Set!" *He placed his hands on the steering wheel and on the gear lever*

"Go!" *The roar of the cars devastated everything and everyone began to shout and cheer their participants. The bets were already rolling* 


*Malcolm could feel the adrenaline running through his veins, a sweet drug that he loved so much, but something caught his attention: the same damn Silver car was running next to him.
Malcolm was anxious and curious to know who was the person driving the car*

*He didn't even suspect that his opponent is a girl*
